predictions.articleTitle: Widzew Łódź vs Unia Skierniewice Tactical Breakdown & Preview: Depleted Host Faces 1. Liga Test
predictions.coreRecommendation: Widzew Łódź's remaining Ekstraklasa core should avoid defeat at home in a tight, rotated friendly built around 1:1 and 2:1 scripts.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win / Draw anchored by Jusuf Gazibegović's right-flank progression, 8 set-piece goals, and Unia's 26 goals conceded in 14 Betclic 1. Liga games (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 Goals supported by 2.25 combined lambda, 60.9% baseline Poisson probability, and Widzew's 73.7% big-chance missed rate (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Second-half friendly substitution variance allowing Unia Skierniewice's five-goal forwards Bartosz Bida and Kamil Sabiłło to score in transition (Confidence: Low, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Depleted Widzew spine tests Unia Skierniewice's in-form strikers.

spf.comment: Retains both Widzew's narrow 2:1 home-win edge and the modal 1:1 draw script because seven international call-ups and four injuries weaken Widzew enough that a single call would understate stalemate risk.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.25 combined lambda (1.20 vs 1.05), a 60.9% baseline Poisson Under 2.5 share, and Widzew's depleted attack without Karol Świderski and Dani Silva.

score.comment: 1:1 reflects the modal Poisson outcome as Unia attack a makeshift Widzew backline, while 2:1 captures Widzew's remaining top-flight starters edging Unia's leaky second-tier defense.

goals.comment: Two goals aligns with the 26.7% Poisson mode and 1:1 core script, while three goals covers late second-half friendly rotation opening space for a 2:1 finish.

bqc.comment: Experimental lineups point toward a level first half before second-half fitness and substitutions decide whether Widzew pull clear (2:1) or remain locked at 1:1.
